BFA.note: Nothing on AI harms rules or authority.
Nothing on AI used by a government body.

Only robotics demonstrations and an AI-themed event; no model, dataset or compute built.
Training announced is for the public, not civil servants.

facts.fact: The organising committee chair, who is the digital ministry's secretary general, announced on 2026-11-09 a free ICT training campaign of about five weeks covering office software, AI, cybersecurity, networks, web and mobile development, with attention to youth, women, displaced people and people with disabilities.
